stories.hook: ¿Puede la psilocibina mejorar la cognición en depresión resistente?
stories.headline: Psilocibina potencia atención y memoria en depresión resistente
stories.finding: La revisión de 20 estudios (2 959 participantes) indicó que la función cognitiva global y la velocidad de procesamiento no cambiaron en voluntarios sanos. En pacientes con depresión resistente al tratamiento, la psilocibina mejoró la atención sostenida, la memoria de trabajo, la función ejecutiva y el procesamiento emocional.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la psilocibina, más allá de su efecto antidepresivo, podría ser una intervención cognitiva en la depresión resistente, ofreciendo una vía para mejorar funciones ejecutivas y emocionales que suelen deteriorarse en estos pacientes.
stories.paperTitle: Impact of psilocybin on cognitive function: A systematic review
stories.originalAbstract: Psilocybin is a classic psychedelic with demonstrated preliminary clinical efficacy in a range of psychiatric disorders. Evaluating the impact of psilocybin on cognitive function is essential to unravel its potential benefits and risks. In this systematic review, we assessed psilocybin's effect on cognitive function through a comprehensive search of electronic databases from inception to January 2024, identifying 20 articles involving 2,959 participants. While 85% of studies were conducted in healthy volunteers, most of these studies (85%) used macrodoses, ranging from 45 μg/kg to 30 mg/70 kg. Various cognitive aspects were evaluated and yielded mixed results. Global cognitive function, and processing speed remained mostly unchanged in healthy individuals; However, a limited number of studies reported improvements in certain areas such as sustained attention, working memory, and executive function especially in patients with treatment-resistant depression (TRD). Emotional processing was positively modified, particularly in TRD patients. Psilocybin was observed to enhance emotional empathy without significantly altering cognitive empathy and social cognition. Cognitive flexibility and creative cognition were noted to initially decline but could potentially improve over time. Additionally, with respect to learning and memory skills, psilocybin showed promise in improving specific memory types such as semantic associations and associative learning, while its effects on episodic and verbal memory have been less pronounced compared to other cognitive enhancers. The observed mixed findings underscore the complexity of psilocybin's cognitive influence. Further research is essential to provide a clearer understanding of psilocybin's impact on cognitive domains and to guide the development of safe and effective interventions.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la rumiación diaria predecir la depresión futura?
stories.headline: La rumiación medida en tiempo real predice síntomas depresivos y ansiosos a 12 meses
stories.finding: En una muestra de 1,176 adolescentes y adultos jóvenes, la media de rumiación evaluada mediante EMA predijo mayores síntomas depresivos y de ansiedad y menor bienestar mental en la línea base y a los seguimientos de 1, 3 y 12 meses, incluso tras ajustar por rumiación trait. Los análisis exploratorios de la inercia de la rumiación arrojaron resultados inconsistentes.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo muestra que la evaluación ecológica de la rumiación captura procesos dinámicos que anticipan la aparición de trastornos, lo que sugiere que la EMA puede guiar intervenciones tempranas y personalizadas en salud mental.
stories.paperTitle: An ecological momentary assessment study assessing repetitive negative thinking as a predictor for psychopathology
stories.originalAbstract: Repetitive negative thinking (RNT), an important transdiagnostic process, is commonly assessed using trait questionnaires. While these instruments ask respondents to estimate their general tendency towards RNT, ecological momentary assessment (EMA) allows to assess how much individuals actually engage in RNT in their daily lives. In a sample of N = 1,176 adolescents and young adults, we investigated whether average levels of RNT assessed via EMA predicted psychopathological symptoms. Adjusting for trait RNT measures and baseline scores on outcome measures, we found that average levels of RNT assessed via EMA significantly predicted higher depressive and anxiety symptoms as well as lower mental well-being at baseline, one-, three-, and twelve-month follow-up. Exploratory analyses of the association between temporal dynamics of RNT (e.g., RNT inertia) and psychopathological symptoms yielded inconsistent results. The high predictive power of average scores on the EMA-based RNT measure suggests that EMA is a promising tool for assessing RNT.

stories.headline: Variantes genéticas de startle se asocian con mayor gravedad de ansiedad
stories.finding: En una muestra de 508 participantes, hallaron evidencia preliminar de que variantes genéticas de la respuesta de sobresalto se asocian con la gravedad de la ansiedad en trastornos psiquiátricos. Estos resultados sugieren que la respuesta de sobresalto podría funcionar como endofenotipo útil para comprender los mecanismos biológicos de la ansiedad.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo permite considerar el sobresalto como endofenotipo para identificar riesgos genéticos y orientar intervenciones que regulen la respuesta fisiológica, mejorando la prevención y el tratamiento de la ansiedad.
stories.paperTitle: Genetic Investigation of Physiological Phenotypes to Understand Anxiety Mechanisms
stories.originalAbstract: The role of genetics in the susceptibility for anxiety disorders is widely acknowledged, and research to identify risk factors has advanced to encompass larger genome-wide approaches. However, using diagnoses in genetic studies limits the search to phenotypes that are very heterogeneous with symptoms spanning many domains (e.g., emotion, cognition, behaviour, physiology). The endophenotype concept in psychiatry aims to remedy this complexity by identifying measurable and genetically modulated traits that link genes with disorders. Across the anxiety disorders, heart rate variability (HRV) has evidence for being diminished, and startle reactivity exaggerated. The overall goal of this thesis is to evaluate the endophenotype potential of reduced HRV and heightened startle for anxiety disorders and determine whether their genetics could shed new light on the biology of pathological anxiety. The first project used a hypothesis-driven set of genetic variants previously related to human startle response, finding preliminary evidence for the association of startle variants with anxiety severity across psychiatric disorders (N = 508). The remaining three projects focused on HRV measured remotely with a wearable device in 120 patients with anxiety disorders and 120 healthy controls. The second project of this thesis validated the relationship of reduced resting HRV with anxiety disorders, also finding an association of lower HRV with greater physical anxiety symptoms. The third project supported the existence of a genetic overlap between anxiety disorders and resting HRV using a polygenic risk score approach. This project also identified a subset of the top variants from a large genome-wide study of HRV that show association with anxiety disorders, with some relationships mediated by resting HRV. The final project found evidence for different patterns of anxiety-modulated HRV in patients with anxiety disorders and healthy controls using a newly created virtual reality (VR) paradigm consisting of exposure to anxiety-inducing and neutral VR conditions. These studies add support for HRV and startle as endophenotypes of anxiety disorders, with their genetics potentially aiding the development of novel medication targets. The combination of symptomatology, genetics, and physiology thus enhances our understanding of mechanisms underlying anxiety disorders which may lead to the establishment of more precise treatment regimens.

stories.hook: ¿Qué factores transdiagnósticos potencian la TCC en trastornos alimentarios?
stories.headline: Identificados 152 meta-análisis revelan objetivos transdiagnósticos para potenciar la TCC
stories.finding: El umbrella review incluyó 152 meta-análisis, de los cuales 44 (29 %) aportaron a 13 meta‑meta‑análisis que sintetizan evidencia sobre factores transdiagnósticos como la preocupación por errores, el perfeccionismo y la baja autoestima. Estos hallazgos sugieren que dichos constructos son dianas prometedoras para la augmentación de la TCC en trastornos alimentarios.
stories.takeaway: Conocer estos factores permite diseñar intervenciones de TCC más focalizadas y escalables, mejorando la eficacia terapéutica y reduciendo la carga clínica de los trastornos alimentarios.
stories.paperTitle: Modifiable Transdiagnostic Risk and Protective Factors as Potential CBT Augmentation Targets for Eating Disorders: An Updated Umbrella Review
stories.originalAbstract: OBJECTIVE: A focus on transdiagnostic targets is one of the key strategies for developing effective, efficient, and scalable treatments for mental health conditions. We conducted an umbrella review of recent meta-analyses (August 2022 to May 2026) to update our understanding of critical transdiagnostic intervention targets that could inform cognitive behavioral therapy augmentation. METHOD: We included prospective cohort, randomized controlled trials, and longitudinal data adopting the search strategy in Hazzard et al. (2023), who previously identified concern over mistakes, perfectionism, and low self-esteem as transdiagnostic targets across depression, anxiety and eating disorders. Six databases were searched including MEDLINE, PsycINFO, Scopus, JBI Database of Systematic Reviews and Implementation Reports, Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, and ProQuest Dissertations & Theses Global. The protocol for this review was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420261295232). RESULTS: One hundred and fifty-two meta-analyses were included in this review, of which 44 (29%) contributed to 13 meta-meta-analyses. The remaining findings were synthesized narratively. Despite a plethora of meta-analyses since 2022, no new transdiagnostic targets have emerged. Significant meta-meta-analytic findings were confined to depression, where physical activity (prospective cohort data) was associated with reduced depressive symptoms, and cognitive biases (longitudinal data) were associated with increased depressive symptoms. DISCUSSION: A disproportionate dominance of depression research may stymie the progress of identifying transdiagnostic targets that are also of relevance to eating disorders. A strong emphasis on physical activity may be contraindicated for eating disorder prevention, especially among youth. Further research effort should be directed toward identifying psychological targets across domains beyond depression.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo se transmite el trauma entre generaciones?
stories.headline: Nuevo inventario revela cinco vías de socialización del trauma intergeneracional en familias lao‑americanas
stories.finding: El Intergenerational Trauma Socialization Inventory mostró una estructura de cinco factores adecuada en un estudio exploratorio con 89 jóvenes adultos lao‑americanos y se confirmó en un análisis factorial confirmatorio con 223 participantes, obteniendo χ²(528)=1038.67, RMSEA=0.07 y CFI=0.90. Los factores identificados incluyen silencio parental, observación de la respuesta parental, instrucción directa, canales culturales y otras vías de transmisión.
stories.takeaway: Este instrumento validado permite identificar mecanismos específicos de transmisión del trauma, facilitando intervenciones clínicas y de investigación dirigidas a romper ciclos de sufrimiento en poblaciones migrantes.
stories.paperTitle: The Psychometric Properties of the Intergenerational Trauma Socialization Inventory: Development and Validation of a Multidimensional Measure of Intergenerational Transmission of Trauma Among Lao American Families
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract Refugees face significant mental health struggles due to violence, torture, and trauma from war, genocide, and the process of migration. The effects of severe trauma extend beyond direct victims of traumatic experiences, shaping the mental health of future generations. Yet, quantitative measures assessing mechanisms of how parental trauma is transmitted from parents to offspring are limited. This study examines the validity of the Intergenerational Trauma Socialization Inventory (ITSI), a new measure that assesses socialization pathways of trauma transmission, among Lao American young adults. The ITSI demonstrated an adequate five-factor structure in exploratory factor analyses in Study 1with a sample of 89 Lao American young adults. In Study 2, confirmatory factor analyses were conducted with a sample of 223 Lao American young adults to confirm the five-factor structure derived from the EFA. The correlated five factor model revealed the best fit, χ2 (528) = 1038.67, p <.05; RMSEA=0.07; CFI=0.90, revealing multiple pathways of trauma transmission: parental silence, observing parental response to past trauma, sharing as instruction, sharing through cultural channels, and internalization of parental trauma. Bivariate correlations indicated that these pathways of trauma transmission were significantly associated with measures of somatic symptoms and depressive symptoms, suggesting concurrent validity. The ITSI also indicated strong reliability (α > 0.84) for all factors. The ITSI can be a helpful measure in assessing pathways of trauma transmission among refugee families and can be used to inform family interventions and community mental health programs to promote health communication pathways in sharing of familial and cultural histories, thereby potentially reducing the impact of trauma on subsequent generations within families and refugee communities.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo adaptar el psicoanálisis al trauma complejo?
stories.headline: Cinco ejes para un psicoanálisis sensible al trauma
stories.finding: El scoping review de intervenciones psicoanalíticas enfocadas en trauma y disociación publicadas en los últimos 15 años identificó cinco ejes de práctica sensible al trauma. Estos ejes abarcan la vulnerabilidad a la desregulación, acceso simbólico limitado, disociación estructural, vulnerabilidad a la desorganización íntima y enactments de colusiones disociativas.
stories.takeaway: Este marco guía a los clínicos para calibrar la interpretación según la capacidad regulatoria y simbólica del paciente traumatizado, mejorando la efectividad y seguridad del proceso terapéutico psicoanalítico.
stories.paperTitle: Recent trends and adaptations in trauma-informed psychoanalytic psychotherapies: A scoping review.
stories.originalAbstract: A growing sensitivity has emerged within psychoanalytic theory and intervention to the specific conditions of complex posttraumatic pathology and its clinical challenges. Yet an articulated, encompassing view of the diverse proposals within this new sensitivity is still lacking. This article advances such articulation through a scoping review of psychoanalytic interventions focused on trauma and dissociation published over the past 15 years. Our analysis identifies five axes of trauma-sensitive psychoanalytic practice addressing vulnerability to dysregulation, limited symbolic access to traumatic material, structural dissociation, vulnerability to disorganization in contexts of intimacy, and enactments arising around dissociative collusions and dilemmas of recognition within the therapeutic dyad. Overall, the reviewed literature relocates interpretation within a temporally and clinically responsive framework, in which the timing and form of interpretive interventions are calibrated to the traumatized patient's regulatory, dissociative, and symbolic capacities. We conclude by outlining essential aspects of the therapeutic stance implied by these contributions. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2026 APA, all rights reserved).

stories.hook: ¿Por qué el malestar momentáneo impulsa el juego?
stories.headline: El malestar momentáneo y estrategias emocionales predicen el juego
stories.finding: En una muestra de 132 adultos australianos, el análisis de efectos mixtos mostró que la intolerancia al malestar momentáneo aumentaba la duración del juego (OR = 1.13, IC 95 % [1.02, 1.25], p = .024). Además, el uso de estrategias emocionales maladaptativas se asoció a mayor probabilidad de episodios de juego (OR = 1.24, IC 95 % [1.03, 1.50], p = .023).
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que intervenir en la tolerancia al malestar y en la regulación emocional en tiempo real podría reducir la frecuencia y duración de las conductas de juego, ofreciendo una guía para tratamientos basados en EMA y estrategias de afrontamiento.
stories.paperTitle: Exploring real-time associations between momentary distress tolerance, emotion regulation, and gambling behavior in Australian adults: An Ecological Momentary Assessment Study.
stories.originalAbstract: Objective: Guided by the dynamic model of relapse, this study examined whether momentary distress intolerance (DI) and emotion regulation (ER; maladaptive and adaptive strategy use) predict gambling behavior (episodes, expenditure, duration) in real time and whether momentary DI and ER interact with each other and with stable (problem gambling severity, high-risk situations) and momentary (psychological distress, state impulsivity) vulnerabilities in predicting gambling episodes.Method: A secondary analysis was conducted on an ecological momentary assessment (EMA) study comprising a pre-EMA survey of stable variables followed by a 28-day period of twice-daily smartphone-delivered EMAs of momentary variables and gambling episodes.The convenience sample included 132 Australian adults (M age = 29.9years; 58.3% male; 94.7% endorsed gambling problems) who reported gambling in a typical month.Results: Mixed-effects logistic regression analyses showed that momentary DI was associated with longer subsequent gambling duration (OR = 1.13, 95% CI [1.02, 1.25], p = .024),and maladaptive ER strategies were associated with both gambling episodes (OR = 1.24, 95% CI [1.03, 1.50], p = .023)and longer subsequent gambling duration (OR = 1.64, 95% CI [1.02, 2.65], p = .042).Adaptive ER strategy use was not significantly associated with gambling behavior.Only DI interacted with state impulsivity (OR = 1.11, 95% CI [1.03, 1.19], p = .005),whereby individuals with low impulsivity were more likely to gamble when DI was low, whereas those with high impulsivity were more likely to gamble when DI was high.Conclusions: These findings contribute to our understanding of DI and ER strategy use as dynamic, momentary vulnerabilities for gambling behavior and highlight their potential as real-time intervention targets, particularly for individuals with high impulsivity. Public Health Significance StatementThis study shows that difficulties tolerating momentary distress and reliance on maladaptive emotion regulation strategies are linked to gambling episodes and sustained gambling duration.Importantly, individuals with high impulsivity were especially likely to gamble when distress intolerance was high.By leveraging real-time data on distress intolerance, emotion regulation, and gambling behavior, these findings support the development of interventions that deliver in-the-moment support to reduce gambling harm.

stories.hook: ¿Los niños con encefalopatías epilépticas duermen peor?
stories.headline: Más del 60 % de niños con encefalopatías epilépticas presentan alteraciones del sueño
stories.finding: En un estudio retrospectivo de 884 pacientes con encefalopatías epilépticas del desarrollo (DEE) y 1 280 controles, se extrajeron notas clínicas mediante procesamiento de lenguaje natural. Se documentó al menos una alteración del sueño en el 63,7 % de los pacientes con DEE, una frecuencia significativamente mayor que en los controles.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo revela que los trastornos del sueño son una comorbilidad frecuente en DEE, lo que sugiere la necesidad de evaluar y tratar el sueño de forma rutinaria en esta población para mejorar su calidad de vida y control de la epilepsia.
stories.paperTitle: Characterizing sleep disturbances in developmental and epileptic encephalopathies through natural language processing: A retrospective monocentric study
stories.originalAbstract: OBJECTIVE: Sleep disorders are frequent but undercharacterized comorbidities in developmental and epileptic encephalopathies (DEEs). We aimed to estimate the frequency, spectrum, and burden of sleep disturbances across genetic DEE subtypes using real-world data extracted from electronic health records (EHRs) through natural language processing (NLP). METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using Dr. Warehouse, an NLP-enabled clinical data warehouse, at a tertiary pediatric center. Data were extracted from January to April 2025. Patients with a group of defined DEEs were identified from narrative clinical notes and matched 1:2 with pediatric neurology patients without history of epilepsy by age, follow-up duration, and document volume. Predefined sleep-related terms were extracted from free-text reports. The proportion of patients with ≥1 documented mention during follow-up was used to estimate occurrence, alongside multivariable logistic regression analyses and a cumulative sleep burden score. RESULTS: The final cohort included 884 patients with DEE and 1280 matched controls. At least one sleep-related disturbance was documented in 63.7% of DEE patients, significantly higher than in controls. The most frequent terms were "sleep disorder," "nocturnal seizures," and "night awakenings." Marked heterogeneity emerged across DEE subtypes; SYNGAP1-DEE showed the highest frequency of sleep disorders, Lennox-Gastaut syndrome was strongly associated with nocturnal seizures, and KCNT1- and PCDH19-DEE were more frequently associated with sleep apnea. DEE patients also exhibited a significantly higher cumulative burden of sleep disturbances compared with controls, with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome showing the greatest burden. SIGNIFICANCE: NLP-based mining of unstructured EHR data enables large-scale characterization of sleep disorders in DEEs, revealing DEE subtype-specific sleep phenotypes. Routine and etiology-informed assessment of sleep disturbances should be integrated into the clinical management of DEEs.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la terapia compasiva mejorar la aceptación de la esclerosis?
stories.headline: Terapias emocionales y compasivas aumentan mindfulness y aceptación en esclerosis múltiple
stories.finding: En un estudio cuasi‑experimental con 54 mujeres con esclerosis múltiple, tanto la Emotion Efficacy Therapy como la Compassion‑Focused Therapy mejoraron significativamente la atención plena disposicional y la aceptación de la enfermedad, sin diferencias entre ellas.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que intervenciones basadas en la regulación emocional o la compasión pueden incorporarse como alternativas eficaces para fomentar mindfulness y aceptación en pacientes con ES, ampliando opciones terapéuticas.
stories.paperTitle: Comparison of the Effectiveness of Emotion Efficacy Therapy and Compassion-Focused Therapy on Dispositional Mindfulness and Illness Acceptance in Women with Multiple Sclerosis
stories.originalAbstract: Objective: The present study aimed to compare the effectiveness of Emotion Efficacy Therapy (EET) and Compassion-Focused Therapy (CFT) on dispositional mindfulness and illness acceptance in women with MS. Materials and Methods: This study employed a quasi-experimental design with pretest-posttest and a control group. The statistical population included all women diagnosed with multiple sclerosis who referred to MS specialty centers in Isfahan during the second half of 2023. A total of 54 women with MS were selected through convenience sampling and were randomly assigned to three groups: Emotion Efficacy Therapy (18 participants), Compassion-Focused Therapy (18 participants), and control group (18 participants). The instruments used in this study included the Five Facet Mindfulness Questionnaire (Baer et al., 2006) and the Illness Acceptance Questionnaire (Bishop et al., 2015). Findings: The findings revealed that both therapeutic approaches were effective in improving dispositional mindfulness (except for the facets of acting with awareness and non-reactivity) and illness acceptance in women with multiple sclerosis. There was no significant difference in the effectiveness of the two therapies on the measured variables. Conclusion: The results suggest that both therapeutic approaches can be considered effective methods for enhancing mindfulness and illness acceptance in women with multiple sclerosis. Given their similar efficacy, the choice between these therapies can be based on client preference or therapist expertise.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo afecta el perfeccionismo a la autoestima en profesionales de salud?
stories.headline: El perfeccionismo maladaptativo mediatiza el impacto del síndrome del impostor en la satisfacción vital
stories.finding: El estudio con 993 profesionales de salud mostró que el fenómeno del impostor incrementa significativamente el perfeccionismo maladaptativo, el cual a su vez disminuye la satisfacción con la vida y eleva el workaholismo y renuncia. Además, el impostor fue más frecuente en hombres y profesionales con menos experiencia.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que intervenir en el perfeccionismo maladaptativo puede mitigar los efectos negativos del síndrome del impostor sobre la autoestima y el bienestar, reduciendo el agotamiento y la rotación laboral en el sector salud.
stories.paperTitle: The other side of the coin: the mediating role of maladaptive perfectionism in the impact of imposter phenomenon on individual and organizational outcomes among healthcare professionals
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract The imposter phenomenon (IP) has been widely studied for its negative psychological effects, yet its organizational implications, particularly in healthcare, remain underexplored. Existing research has mostly focused on individual outcomes such as anxiety, burnout, and stress, while neglecting integrative models that explain how IP leads to broader personal and organizational consequences. In particular, the mediating role of maladaptive perfectionism (MP) in linking IP to reduced life satisfaction, increased workaholism, and higher turnover intention has not been systematically examined in healthcare contexts. This study addresses this gap by developing and testing an integrative structural model that positions MP as a key psychological mechanism through which IP affects both individual and organizational outcomes. Data were collected via a survey of 993 healthcare professionals in Istanbul, Türkiye, and analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM). The results show that IP significantly increases MP, which in turn reduces life satisfaction and increases workaholism and turnover intention. Additionally, IP was found to be more prevalent among men and less experienced healthcare professionals, particularly resident physicians. By empirically confirming MP as the central mediator between IP and its detrimental outcomes, this study advances theoretical understanding of psychological strain in high-pressure healthcare environments. It also provides practical guidance for healthcare organizations, suggesting that early interventions and institutional awareness strategies, such as mentorship programs and feedback systems, can help mitigate perfectionism-driven risks and support workforce well-being while sustaining high-quality patient care.

stories.hook: ¿Qué impulsa a médicos y enfermeras a abandonar su puesto?
stories.headline: Seis determinantes clave explican la intención de renuncia en la pandemia
stories.finding: Una revisión sistemática de 55 estudios y un meta‑análisis de 33 estudios identificaron seis temas determinantes: características personales, demandas laborales, servicios de empleo, condiciones de trabajo, relaciones laborales y cultura organizacional, que influyen en la intención de dejar el empleo durante la COVID‑19.
stories.takeaway: Comprender estos factores permite diseñar intervenciones dirigidas a mejorar la retención del personal sanitario, reduciendo la escasez de profesionales críticos en situaciones de crisis.
stories.paperTitle: Determinants of intention to leave among nurses and physicians in a hospital setting during the COVID-19 pandemic: A systematic review and meta-analysis
stories.originalAbstract: BACKGROUND: The global outbreak of COVID-19 has brought to light the profound impact that large-scale disease outbreaks can have on healthcare systems and the dedicated professionals who serve within them. It becomes increasingly important to explore strategies for retaining nurses and physicians within hospital settings during such challenging times. This paper aims to investigate the determinants of retention among nurses and physicians during the COVID-19 pandemic. METHOD: A systematic review of other potential determinants impacting retention rates during the pandemic was carried out. Secondly, a meta-analysis on the prevalence of intention to leave for nurses and physicians during the COVID-19 pandemic. FINDINGS: A comprehensive search was performed within four electronic databases on March 17 2023. Fifty-five papers were included in the systematic review, whereas thirty-three papers fulfilled the eligibility criteria for the meta-analysis. The systematic review resulted in six themes of determinants impacting intention to leave: personal characteristics, job demands, employment services, working conditions, work relationships, and organisational culture. The main determinants impacting the intention to leave are the fear of COVID-19, age, experience, burnout symptoms and support. Meta-analysis showed a prevalence of intent to leave the current job of 38% for nurses (95% CI: 26%-51%) and 29% for physicians (95% CI: 21%-39%), whereas intention to leave the profession for nurses 28% (95% CI: 21%-34%) and 24% for physicians (95% CI: 23%-25%). CONCLUSION: The findings of this paper showed the critical need for hospital managers to address the concerning increase in nurses' and physicians' intentions to leave during the COVID-19 pandemic. This intention to leave is affected by a complex conjunction of multiple determinants, including the fear of COVID-19 and the confidence in and availability of personal protective equipment. Moreover, individual factors like age, experience, burnout symptoms, and support are maintained in this review. Understanding the influence of determinants on retention during the COVID-19 pandemic offers an opportunity to formulate prospective strategies for retaining nurses and physicians within hospital settings.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo la inseguridad de apego erosiona la satisfacción conyugal?
stories.headline: Inseguridades de apego reducen la satisfacción marital mediante patrones de comunicación disfuncionales
stories.finding: Un estudio longitudinal con 263 parejas mostró que las inseguridades de apego se asocian indirectamente con menor satisfacción conyugal a través de patrones de comunicación demand/withdraw y withdraw/withdraw. Además, los eventos estresantes moderan estas relaciones, revelando diferencias según el género de la pareja.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo subraya la necesidad de intervenir en la comunicación de parejas con inseguridades de apego, especialmente bajo estrés, para prevenir la disminución de la satisfacción marital, orientando terapias de pareja hacia la reparación de patrones demand/withdraw.
stories.paperTitle: The Role of Communication in Romantic Attachment and Relationship Satisfaction: A Dyadic Longitudinal Study
stories.journal: Journal of Marital and Family Therapy
stories.originalAbstract: Researchers and clinicians note that romantic attachment insecurities, negative communication, and stressors interact in ways that gradually undermine relationship satisfaction over time. Grounding clinical models in empirical findings is crucial. This longitudinal study examined the mediating role of communication patterns in associations between romantic attachment insecurities and relationship satisfaction, while accounting for stressful life events. Path analyses conducted with 263 couples over a year revealed that attachment insecurities were indirectly associated with lower relationship satisfaction in both partners via greater use of demand/withdraw and demand/demand communication patterns. Attachment avoidance was indirectly associated with lower satisfaction in both partners via the withdraw/withdraw communication pattern. Results indicated differences according to dyad gender and revealed that stressful life events played a moderating role in the associations between attachment insecurities and communication patterns. The findings provide support for the theoretical underpinnings of both attachment-based and communication-based couple interventions, highlighting their clinical value.

stories.hook: ¿La IA sustituye la fe en la adivinación?
stories.headline: IA de GenAI reemplaza la adivinación tradicional, ofreciendo confort psicológico.
stories.finding: Entre 22 participantes, quienes buscan consuelo psicológico mostraron mayor receptividad a la toma de decisiones basada en GenAI, valorando su accesibilidad y eficiencia, aunque perciben la falta de mística espiritual. La interacción comunitaria reforzó interpretaciones mediante la repetición de consultas hasta que las respuestas coincidieran con sus expectativas.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo revela cómo la IA puede sustituir rituales tradicionales, ofreciendo consuelo psicológico y fomentando dinámicas comunitarias que validan las respuestas generadas. Comprender estos procesos es esencial para diseñar intervenciones digitales que respeten la dimensión cultural y psicológica de la búsqueda de significado.
stories.paperTitle: "Re-Tell the Fortune so I Can Believe It": How Chinese User Communities Engage with and Interpret GenAI-based Fortune-Telling
stories.journal: Proceedings of the ACM on Human-Computer Interaction
stories.originalAbstract: People traditionally divine the future by interpreting natural phenomena as oracular signals, especially in societies adhering to traditional beliefs like China. With the advent of Generative AI (GenAI), people gain access to new ways of probing digital oracles for predicting the future. To understand how people use and interpret GenAI for divination in China, we interviewed 22 participants who habitually use GenAI platforms for fortune-telling, complemented by a three-week digital ethnography with 1,842 community posts. Qualitative analysis showed that people who seek psychological comfort are particularly receptive to GenAI-based decision-making. Users valued GenAI’s accessibility, convenience, and efficiency while perceiving its lack of spiritual mystique. We observed community dynamics forming around GenAI tools, where users reinforce interpretations by sharing and discussing with each other, repeating queries until responses align with expectations. Our work uncovers how AI technologies change the way people and communities engage in traditional cultural practices while yearning for the same goals.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué compramos compulsivamente a pesar de saber el daño?
stories.headline: Los impulsores emocionales y cognitivos del trastorno de compra compulsiva
stories.finding: El trabajo muestra que la falta de regulación emocional y los sesgos cognitivos generan y perpetúan la adicción a las compras, con alta prevalencia y graves efectos. Sugiere terapia cognitivo-conductual, mindfulness y herramientas de big data y realidad virtual como estrategias de prevención y tratamiento.
stories.takeaway: Comprender estos mecanismos permite a los profesionales diseñar intervenciones integradas que combinan CBT, mindfulness y tecnologías digitales, mejorando la eficacia terapéutica y reduciendo el impacto socioeconómico de la adicción al consumo.
stories.paperTitle: Behavioral Insights into Shopping Addiction: Emotional and Cognitive Drivers
stories.journal: Technium Romanian Journal of Applied Sciences and Technology
stories.originalAbstract: This paper will seek to explain the behavioral underpinnings of shopping addiction, focusing on the emotional and cognitive drivers. It has explored the prevalence and serious impact of shopping addiction and highlighted the complexity of both the emotional and cognitive elements involved in triggering and sustaining the behavior. This paper also explores the role of emotional regulation in shopping addiction and suggests potential therapeutic implications that can be derived from deeper knowledge in this respect. The treatment options proposed include behavioral interventions, such as cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) and mindfulness-based strategies. The new approaches in the use of technology in big data analytics and virtual reality applications for understanding and intervention in shopping addiction are briefly addressed. It concludes by stating that there needs to be more research carried out on online shopping behavior and e-therapies, effective prevention strategies, and all this while considering ethical concerns in behavioral data collection. Finally, this paper synthesizes cross-disciplinary research with a view to offering an integrated insight into shopping addiction and its treatment and points out the increased applicability of technological innovations in this field.

stories.hook: ¿Puede el apoyo entre compañeros reducir el trauma de una pérdida?
stories.headline: El apoyo de pares atenúa PTSD y riesgo de suicidio tras la muerte de un colega
stories.finding: En una encuesta a 58,299 bomberos surcoreanos (92,6 % de respuesta), la muerte de un colega se asoció a mayor PTSD y riesgo de suicidio. El apoyo percibido de los pares redujo significativamente esa asociación, mientras que el daño emocional por labor emocional y los problemas de alcohol mediaron el efecto.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo muestra que fortalecer redes de apoyo entre compañeros puede ser una estrategia preventiva clave para reducir PTSD y suicidio tras pérdidas traumáticas, orientando a organizaciones a implementar programas de apoyo entre pares que fomenten la resiliencia ocupacional.
stories.paperTitle: Role of peer support in mitigating PTSD and suicide risk among firefighters experiencing colleagues’ death
stories.originalAbstract: Background: The impact of witnessing a colleague’s line-of-duty death or suicide on firefighters is profound, potentially elevating the risk of post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and suicide risk. Although violent loss has been acknowledged as more traumatic than natural loss, research exploring the specific outcomes of experiencing a colleague’s death within these contexts are scarce.Methods: Of 58,299 South Korean firefighters, 53,980 (92.6%) participated in the survey. Posttraumatic symptoms, suicide risk, alcohol-related problems, emotional damage due to emotional labour, and perceived support from colleagues were assessed. Moderated mediation effects were analyzed using SPSS PROCESS macro Model 88.Results: The findings highlighted the significant mediating roles of emotional damage due to emotional labour and alcohol-related problems in the relationship between colleagues’ death experiences and PTSD or suicide risk. Additionally, peer support mitigated the impact of experiencing colleagues’ death on PTSD symptoms and suicide risk.Conclusions: Our study sheds light on the complex interplay between grief, traumatic responses, and peer support in firefighters, suggesting enhancing peer support as an important intervention component to mitigate the psychological impact of witnessing a colleague’s death. This study not only broadens our understanding of firefighter bereavement and mental health challenges but also underscores the importance of targeted therapeutic strategies to prevent PTSD and suicidal behaviours in this high-risk population.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué la memoria de trabajo frena la inhibición en TDAH?
stories.headline: La carga de memoria de trabajo deteriora la inhibición en niños con TDAH
stories.finding: En un experimento con 110 niños con TDAH, ansiedad o ambas, se manipuló la carga de memoria de trabajo y la exigencia de inhibición. Al aumentar la demanda de memoria de trabajo, las respuestas fueron más lentas y la precisión disminuyó en las tareas de inhibición (BF10>317, p<.001, d=0.67‑1.53).
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo apoya modelos que atribuyen los déficits del TDAH a una capacidad limitada de la memoria de trabajo, sugiriendo que intervenciones que reduzcan la carga cognitiva podrían mejorar la inhibición y el rendimiento académico.
stories.paperTitle: Working memory and inhibitory control deficits in children with ADHD: an experimental evaluation of competing model predictions
stories.originalAbstract: Introduction Children with ADHD demonstrate difficulties on many different neuropsychological tests. However, it remains unclear whether this pattern reflects a large number of distinct deficits or a small number of deficit(s) that broadly impact test performance. The current study is among the first experiments to systematically manipulate demands on both working memory and inhibition, with implications for competing conceptual models of ADHD pathogenesis. Method A clinically evaluated, carefully phenotyped sample of 110 children with ADHD, anxiety disorders, or co-occurring ADHD+anxiety (Mage=10.35, 44 girls; 69% White Not Hispanic/Latino) completed a counterbalanced, double dissociation experiment, with two tasks each per inhibition (low vs. high) x working memory (low vs. high) condition. Results Bayesian and frequentist models converged in indicating that both manipulations successfully increased demands on their target executive function (BF10>5.33x108, p<.001). Importantly, occupying children’s limited capacity working memory system produced slower response times and reduced accuracy on inhibition tasks (BF10>317.42, p<.001, d=0.67-1.53). It also appeared to differentially reduce inhibition (and non-inhibition) accuracy for children with ADHD relative to children with anxiety (BF10=2.03, p=.02, d=0.50). In contrast, there was strong evidence against models that view working memory deficits as secondary outcomes of underlying inhibition deficits in ADHD (BF01=18.52, p=.85). Discussion This pattern indicates that working memory broadly affects children’s ability to inhibit prepotent tendencies and maintain fast/accurate performance, and may explain the errors that children with ADHD make on inhibition tests. These findings are broadly consistent with models describing working memory as a causal mechanism that gives rise to secondary impairments. In contrast, these findings provide evidence against models that view disinhibition as a cause of working memory difficulties or view working memory as a non-causal correlate or epiphenomenon in ADHD.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la tecnología digital mejorar la salud mental infantil?
stories.headline: Tecnología digital muestra efecto positivo significativo en la salud mental de niños y adolescentes
stories.finding: El estudio revisó 59 investigaciones empíricas sobre tecnologías digitales y realizó una meta‑análisis con 10 estudios experimentales, revelando un efecto global positivo de estas intervenciones en la salud mental de niños y adolescentes. Además, se observó una tendencia creciente en la producción científica durante la última década.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo respalda la incorporación de herramientas digitales en programas preventivos y terapéuticos, ofreciendo una alternativa accesible y escalable para mejorar el bienestar psicológico infantil, lo que puede guiar políticas y prácticas clínicas.
stories.paperTitle: Promoting mental health in children and adolescents through digital technology: a systematic review and meta-analysis
stories.originalAbstract: Background The increasing prevalence of mental health issues among children and adolescents has prompted a growing number of researchers and practitioners to explore digital technology interventions, which offer convenience, diversity, and proven effectiveness in addressing such problems. However, the existing literature reveals a significant gap in comprehensive reviews that consolidate findings and discuss the potential of digital technologies in enhancing mental health. Methods To clarify the latest research progress on digital technology to promote mental health in the past decade (2013–2023), we conducted two studies: a systematic review and meta-analysis. The systematic review is based on 59 empirical studies identified from three screening phases, with basic information, types of technologies, types of mental health issues as key points of analysis for synthesis and comparison. The meta-analysis is conducted with 10 qualified experimental studies to determine the overall effect size of digital technology interventions and possible moderating factors. Results The results revealed that (1) there is an upward trend in relevant research, comprising mostly experimental and quasi-experimental designs; (2) the common mental health issues include depression, anxiety, bullying, lack of social emotional competence, and mental issues related to COVID-19; (3) among the various technological interventions, mobile applications (apps) have been used most frequently in the diagnosis and treatment of mental issues, followed by virtual reality, serious games, and telemedicine services; and (4) the meta-analysis results indicated that digital technology interventions have a moderate and significant effect size ( g = 0.43) for promoting mental health. Conclusion Based on these findings, this study provides guidance for future practice and research on the promotion of adolescent mental health through digital technology. Systematic review registration https://inplasy.com/inplasy-2023-12-0004/ , doi: 10.37766/inplasy2023.12.0004 .

The systematic review is based on 59 empirical studies identified from three screening phases, with basic information, types of technologies, types of mental health issues as key points of analysis for synthesis and comparison. The meta-analysis is conducted with 10 qualified experimental studies to determine the overall effect size of digital technology interventions and possible moderating factors. Results The results revealed that (1) there is an upward trend in relevant research, comprising mostly experimental and quasi-experimental designs; (2) the common mental health issues include depression, anxiety, bullying, lack of social emotional competence, and mental issues related to COVID-19; (3) among the various technological interventions, mobile applications (apps) have been used most frequently in the diagnosis and treatment of mental issues, followed by virtual reality, serious games, and telemedicine services; and (4) the meta-analysis results indicated that digital technology interventions have a moderate and significant effect size ( g = 0.43) for promoting mental health. Conclusion Based on these findings, this study provides guidance for future practice and research on the promotion of adolescent mental health through digital technology. Systematic review registration https://inplasy.com/inplasy-2023-12-0004/ , doi: 10.37766/inplasy2023.12.0004 .

stories.hook: ¿Puede una proteína cerebral acelerar la extinción del miedo?
stories.headline: La sobreexpresión de CDNF acelera la extinción de la memoria de miedo en ratas
stories.finding: En ratas, la sobreexpresión de CDNF en el hipocampo aceleró la extinción de la memoria de miedo contextual y condicionada. A nivel molecular, activó la señalización de la respuesta al estrés del retículo (PERK, ATF6, XBP1), aumentó la actividad de CREB y potenció la excitabilidad y conectividad neuronal.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que CDNF podría ser un objetivo terapéutico para facilitar la extinción de recuerdos traumáticos, ofreciendo una vía novedosa para tratar trastornos de ansiedad y estrés postraumático mediante la modulación de la plasticidad sináptica.
stories.paperTitle: Cerebral dopamine neurotrophic factor (CDNF) affects hippocampal neuroplasticity and fear memory in rats
stories.originalAbstract: The role of CDNF in modulating learning and memory remains largely unexplored. Here, hippocampal CDNF overexpression significantly accelerated extinction of contextual and cued fear memory in rats. Molecularly, overexpressed CDNF was retained in the ER and upregulated mRNA levels of Perk , Atf6 , and spliced Xbp1 , indicating activation of UPR-related signaling. Furthermore, CDNF overexpression increased CREB transcription and phosphorylation. Additionally, Cdnf mRNA levels correlated positively with transcript levels of Bdnf exons I, II, and IV. In primary hippocampal neurons, CDNF enhanced spontaneous bioelectrical activity, network burst complexity, and functional connectivity, as evidenced by multielectrode array and calcium imaging. These findings suggest that CDNF facilitates fear memory extinction, potentially through UPR-related signaling and enhanced neuronal excitability and network synchronization, positioning it as a potential regulator of hippocampal-dependent plasticity.
